compactPlayerBar.hint: Fits track information, compact transport controls, seek, and popup volume into one small row.

keepPanels.hint: Leaves a dock panel in place after its last tab closes instead of letting neighboring panels fill the space.

windowTitle.hint: Shows the current track title in the main app window title. Turn it off to always show only "izci".

alwaysUpNext.hint: Keeps the Up Next panel under the Queue expanded and visible, even when it is empty.

contents.heading: What is included
contents.included: User-facing options, workspace settings, Raf presets, loadouts, library tracks and metadata, favorites, folder descriptors, play counts, and remembered playback positions.
contents.excluded: Media files, file and directory handles, artwork cache, lyrics, live meters, pattern snapshots, object URLs, temporary window state, update timestamps, and cross-window coordination state.
contents.privacy: Backups are not encrypted. They can contain filenames, paths, metadata, favorites, and listening progress.

multiplayer.hostingHint: Server connection details live under Hosting.

coop.title: Co-op
coop.hint: Clients can control the host’s queue and playback. Good for HTPCs, parties.

coopAudio.title: Co-op + audio
coopAudio.hint: Clients can control the host and listen to its audio stream on their own device.

freeplay.title: Freeplay
freeplay.hint: Clients can browse and play music from the host’s library independently, with their own queue, playback, and audio.

multiplayer.name: Name this izci
multiplayer.nameHint: Shown to hosts and clients in multiplayer sessions.

motd.title: Message of the day
motd.hint: Shown above the chat to guests in sessions hosted by this izci.

history.title: Preserve chat history
history.hint: Keeps the latest chat lines on this device and restores them when it hosts again.

waitForClients.title: Wait for clients
waitForClients.hint: Before starting a track, waits until every connected listener has loaded its transferred file or tuned to the audio stream.

restoreSession.title: Restore last session
restoreSession.hint: Reconnects to a remembered izci-server invitation after relaunch. Hosting requires login.

maxListeners.title: Maximum guests
maxListeners.hint: Limits how many guests can connect to the host at once, whether or not audio streaming is enabled.

synchronizedPlayback.title: Synchronized playback
synchronizedPlayback.hint: Coordinates a shared start time across the host and listeners. Works best with sent files; streamed audio remains best effort because browser buffers vary.

syncLeadTime.title: Start lead time
syncLeadTime.hint: How far ahead the host schedules a synchronized start after every listener is ready. Increase it when devices miss the opening beat.

fileTransfer.title: Send files under
fileTransfer.hint: Sends smaller audio and module files whole, then plays them on each listener. Larger files are pre-rendered to buffered Opus by the host. Modules are usually small, so they transfer directly.

opusBitrate.title: Opus VBR bitrate
opusBitrate.hint: Controls the bitrate of the pre-rendered Opus stream each listener downloads. Higher rates use more host bandwidth and encoding work.

audioBuffer.title: Start/rebuffer after
audioBuffer.hint: How much audio each listener buffers before playback starts and after a rebuffer. Download keeps running ahead while paused.

renderCache.title: Pre-render memory limit
renderCache.hint: How much host memory the compressed render cache may use. Active tracks stay pinned; older renders are evicted by least-recent use.

diagnostics.heading: Connection diagnostics
diagnostics.upnp: A static public IP or router UPnP is no guarantee: Chromium picks its own ICE ports and izci never requests a UPnP mapping.
diagnostics.messages: No candidates at all points to browser or network policy; local-only candidates point to STUN failure; candidates on both sides with no connection point to NAT or firewall filtering.

serverEndpoint.title: izci-server
serverEndpoint.hint: HTTPS base URL of the self-hosted server, including any path prefix. Empty means no server is configured and no multiplayer requests are made.

server.resumeHint: Resume a remembered room after a restart with a fresh login.
server.rememberHost: Remember this room on this device
server.rememberHostHint: Keeps the room and invitation secrets for resume. Operator-key storage is controlled separately above.
server.hostInviteHint: Share this link. Guests see the destination and confirm before anything connects.
server.pasteHint: Paste a #party link. It is parsed locally and its secret is cleared from the address bar.
server.joinCoopHint: Listen together and share the host's queue and transport.
server.joinFreeplayHint: Browse the host library and play your own picks. Needs freeplay on both ends.
server.pendingHint: Confirm the destination, then choose how to join. Server details load only after joining.
server.providersTitle: The server declares these ICE providers
server.providersHint: Continue only if these look expected. The choice is remembered per server.
server.forceRelayHint: Used when the server advertises a relay. Direct routes are still tried first unless the operator requires otherwise.
server.iceManaged: STUN and TURN are supplied by the izci-server operator. This client does not configure relay credentials.
server.recentsEmpty: No saved host rooms or guest invitations.
server.needsMainWindow: Hosting and joining run from the main window.
server.loginExpired: That login expired. Enter the operator key again.

enable.title: Keep renders between sessions
enable.hint: Saves buffered Opus renders to a separate IndexedDB cache so rejoining or replaying a track skips the re-download. Entries are validated against the host manifest and are rebuilt on demand, never part of your library.

limit.title: Size limit
limit.hint: How much disk space the client render cache may use. The least-recently-heard renders are evicted first.

tracks.heading: Cached renders

displayStyle.title: Display style
displayStyle.hint: Chooses how embedded synced lyrics render in the Lyrics panel.

fontSize.title: Font size
fontSize.hint: Saves a separate size for Plain text, Timestamped rows, and Theater.

autoScroll.title: Auto scroll to current line
autoScroll.hint: Keeps the highlighted lyric row in view while playback advances.

downtimeDots.title: Downtime dots
downtimeDots.hint: Shows a three-dot break marker during long gaps between synced lines.

downtimeAfter.title: Downtime after
downtimeAfter.hint: Sets how long a synced lyric gap must last before Theater shows the break marker.

smoothTheaterScroll.title: Smooth Theater scroll
smoothTheaterScroll.hint: Animates Theater line changes instead of snapping directly to the active line.

inferFromFilename.title: Infer artist/title from filename
inferFromFilename.hintBeforeExample: When enabled, izci parses filenames like

playCountThreshold.title: Count track as played after (seconds)
playCountThreshold.hint: Only tracks that are in the library update their play count.

panStrength.title: Pan strength
panStrength.hint: Below 100 narrows the image, above 100 widens it.

tempoFactor.title: Tempo factor
tempoFactor.hint: Changes module playback speed without changing pitch.

pitchFactor.title: Pitch factor
pitchFactor.hint: Adjusts playback pitch relative to the module's original tuning.

openWhenMaximized.title: Open when maximized
openWhenMaximized.hint: Switches the main window to Now Playing while it is maximized or fullscreen.

hideSideChrome.title: Hide controls after inactivity
hideSideChrome.hint: Fades transport, side handles, and unpinned panels. Pinned panels stay visible.

artworkColors.title: Always use artwork colors
artworkColors.hint: Forces the focused player controls to use artwork colors. When off, Now Playing follows the main player setting.

flyoutTransparency.title: Flyout transparency
flyoutTransparency.hint: Lets the Now Playing backdrop show through flyout panel surfaces without fading their contents.

multiplayerFloaters.title: Multiplayer floaters
multiplayerFloaters.hint: Shows connected co-op and Freeplay clients around the edges of Now Playing.

multiplayerFloaterSize.title: Multiplayer floater size
multiplayerFloaterSize.hint: Scales the floating client cards without changing the rest of Now Playing.

multiplayerFloaterMotion.title: Multiplayer buoyancy
multiplayerFloaterMotion.hint: Controls how far cards gently drift and tilt. Set it to zero for still water.

autoTheater.title: Auto switch to Theater
autoTheater.hint: Uses the large focused lyrics layout while Now Playing is active.

autoFocusLyrics.title: Auto focus Lyrics tab
autoFocusLyrics.hint: Opens Now Playing directly to the lyrics view.

textSize.title: Pattern text size
textSize.hint: Scales tracker cells independently from the app interface font.

rowHeight.title: Row height
rowHeight.hint: Controls how densely pattern rows pass through the playhead.

channelWidth.title: Channel width
channelWidth.hint: Sets the horizontal room reserved for each formatted tracker channel.

follow.title: Follow the playhead
follow.hint: Scrolls automatically to keep the current row in view while a module plays.

alwaysCenter.title: Always center current row
alwaysCenter.hint: Adds space around the first and last rows so the playhead stays vertically centered for the entire pattern.

smoothScroll.title: Smooth playhead scrolling
smoothScroll.hint: Animates row centering instead of stepping directly to the current row.

channelNames.title: Show channel names
channelNames.hint: Adds module-provided names beside channel numbers when they are available.

highlightBeats.title: Highlight beat rows
highlightBeats.hint: Adds a subtle guide every four rows behind the moving playhead.

rowNumbers.title: Row numbers
rowNumbers.hint: Uses familiar hexadecimal tracker numbering or ordinary decimal values.

colors.title: Pattern colors
colors.hint: Colors notes, instruments, volume commands, and effects for easier scanning.

restore.title: Restore playback
restore.hint: Restores the current track and position after a reload. Position and state also resumes playback when Chromium allows it.

replayGain.title: ReplayGain
replayGain.hint: Applies streamed-file ReplayGain tags, preferring track or album gain when both are available.

replayGainPreamp.title: Preamp
replayGainPreamp.hint: Shifts the applied ReplayGain in dB before peak limiting.

manual.title: Fade manual track changes
manual.hint: Sets how much of the standard fade or crossfade duration applies when you choose Previous, Next, or another track.

mode.title: Track transition
mode.hint: Cuts directly, fades the outgoing track to silence, or overlaps adjacent tracks.

gapless.title: Gapless playback
gapless.hint: Prepares the next file before the current one ends. Turning this off also disables crossfade.

duration.title: Fade length
duration.hint: Sets the fade-out or overlap duration.

rememberProgress.title: Remember progress
rememberProgress.hint: Automatically resumes unfinished files at least this long when you return to them.

restartCurrentTrackOnPrevious.title: Previous restarts current track
restartCurrentTrackOnPrevious.hint: Restarts the current track when Previous is pressed after 3 seconds; press it again to go to the previous track.

playbackRate.title: Playback speed
playbackRate.hint: Changes the playback speed of streamed audio and video. Tracker modules use their own tempo and pitch controls.

trueSpeed.title: True speed
trueSpeed.hint: Disables timestretching so pitch rises or falls along with playback speed.

logarithmicVolume.title: Logarithmic volume
logarithmicVolume.hint: Shapes the volume slider for gentler low-end changes.

enableRaf.title: Enable Raf
enableRaf.hint: Enables the built-in audio effects rack and shows Raf under Playback.

showRafToggle.title: Show Raf toggle in player bar
showRafToggle.hint: Shows the rack bypass control beside volume while Raf is enabled. Right-clicking it opens Raf options.

folderNesting.title: Folder nesting limit
folderNesting.hint: How many subfolder levels folder opens and folder drops traverse. Use 0 to read only files directly inside the selected folder.

verify.title: Verify added files
verify.hint: Check unknown file extensions in a separate muted OpenMPT player before adding them. When disabled, izci adds any unknown file as a tracker module and lets normal playback report whether it works. Official OpenMPT extensions are accepted directly either way.

associatedFiles.title: Files opened with izci
associatedFiles.hint: Choose how files opened through operating-system file associations affect the current queue.

favoriteToggle.title: Show favorite toggle
favoriteToggle.hint: Show a heart button after the transport controls for adding or removing the current track or module subsong from Favorites.

ratings.heading: Ratings
ratings.title: Enable track ratings
ratings.hint: Show half-star rating controls and the Rating library column. Turning this off hides ratings without deleting them.

deduplicateQueue.title: Deduplicate queue additions
deduplicateQueue.hint: Skip tracks already in the queue and repeated tracks within the same addition.

autoResizeWindow.title: Auto resize window
autoResizeWindow.hint: Resizes an unsuitable player window to 1280 × 720 when video or image display starts, then restores it when other playback begins.

autoEnterTheater.title: Auto enter theater
autoEnterTheater.hint: Opens videos and images in theater automatically when they start.

style.title: Style
style.hint: Controls how the spectrum analyzer is drawn behind the full player bar.

colorSource.title: Color source
colorSource.hint: Uses the current artwork palette when available, otherwise falls back to the active theme.

height.title: Height
height.hint: Sets how far the analyzer can rise through the player background.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.hint: Sets how strongly the analyzer appears behind text, controls, and artwork.

frameCap.title: Frame cap
frameCap.hint: Limits how often every visualizer style redraws, from battery-friendlier motion to high-refresh displays.

normalization.title: Normalization
normalization.hint: Balances low, mid, and high frequency bands so bass-heavy or bright tracks still use the full visual range.

triangleCount.title: Triangle count
triangleCount.hint: Sets how many triangle shapes are kept active in the player background.

triangleMinSize.title: Minimum triangle size
triangleMinSize.hint: Sets the smallest triangle size as a percentage of the player bar height.

triangleMaxSize.title: Maximum triangle size
triangleMaxSize.hint: Sets the largest triangle size as a percentage of the player bar height.

triangleBaseSpeed.title: Base rise speed
triangleBaseSpeed.hint: Multiplies the baseline upward movement before rhythm response is applied.

triangleReactiveSpeed.title: Reactive rise speed
triangleReactiveSpeed.hint: Multiplies the extra upward speed added by amplitude and beat pulses.

triangleBorderWidth.title: Border thickness
triangleBorderWidth.hint: Sets a fixed outline width shared by every triangle, regardless of size.

layout.title: Layout
layout.hint: Selects the ten-foot home layout. Waterfall is the only layout today.

songsLayout.title: Song browser layout
songsLayout.hint: Shows songs as a compact list or as an artwork grid in Oda.

fullscreen.title: Enter browser fullscreen
fullscreen.hint: Requests fullscreen when Oda is entered. Oda stays usable when the request is denied, unavailable, or exited with the browser shortcut; a deep-link entry asks again on the first keypress.

wrapNavigation.title: Wrap navigation
wrapNavigation.hint: Lets directional navigation wrap past the ends of a list or row.

overscan.title: Overscan inset
overscan.hint: Adds a safe-area inset around the Oda layout for televisions that crop the edges.

background.title: Background
background.hint: Shows a custom image behind the Oda layout.

backgroundImage.title: Background image
backgroundImage.hint: The image shown behind the Oda layout.

backgroundOpacity.title: Background opacity
backgroundOpacity.hint: How opaque the custom background image is.

useHostBackground.title: Use host background
useHostBackground.hint: When connected as a multiplayer client, automatically fetches and uses the host's Oda background image.

delay.title: Screensaver
delay.hint: Starts the Oda screensaver after this much idle time. It shuffles library images and falls back to theme colors.

move.title: Move screensaver text
move.hint: How often the clock and Now Playing text fade into new positions to reduce burn-in.

arrowRepeatInitialDelay.title: Arrow-repeat initial delay
arrowRepeatInitialDelay.hint: How long a directional key must be held before Oda starts repeating it.

arrowRepeatInterval.title: Arrow-repeat interval
arrowRepeatInterval.hint: How often a held directional key repeats after the initial delay.

holdBack.title: Hold Back action
holdBack.hint: What holding Back does. Exiting Oda stays an explicit Options command.

holdBackThreshold.title: Hold Back threshold
holdBackThreshold.hint: How long Back must be held before the Hold Back action triggers.
